query: multi-turn reinforcement learning user simulation benchmarks
editable training systems for tool-using agents
methods improving user-centric agents with simulated users
text:
1. **EAU: Environment–Agent–User Co-evolution for Training User-Centric Agents** — A meta-agent jointly improves the user simulator, environment, rewards, and RL configuration during training; reports up to 36.7% better task completion. **People:** Min Cai and Xi Ye (University of Alberta/Amii); Dan Zhang (National University of Singapore); Gao Xing and Libin Ma (Kuaishou Technology); Zhaohui Xu (independent).  
   URL: [https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16523](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16523)

2. **Training Proactive and Personalized LLM Agents** — Introduces UserVille, which simulates configurable preferences, and PPP reinforcement learning, which jointly optimizes productivity, proactivity, and personalization. **People:** Weiwei Sun, Xuhui Zhou, Weihua Du, Sean Welleck, Maarten Sap, Yiming Yang (Carnegie Mellon University); Xingyao Wang and Graham Neubig (CMU/OpenHands).  
   URL: [https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.02208](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.02208)

3. **Beyond Cooperative Simulators: Generating Realistic User Personas for Robust Evaluation of LLM Agents** — Persona Policies use evolutionary program search to generate diverse, less cooperative simulated users; training with them improved real-human task success by 23% in the latest paper version. **People:** Harshita Chopra, Kshitish Ghate, Aylin Caliskan, Chirag Shah, Natasha Jaques (University of Washington); Tadayoshi Kohno (Georgetown University).  
   URL: [https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12894](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12894)

4. **Mind the Sim2Real Gap in User Simulation for Agentic Tasks** — Compares 31 simulators with 451 human participants and introduces the User-Sim Index for auditing behavioral and feedback fidelity before simulators are used to improve agents. **People:** Xuhui Zhou, Weiwei Sun, Qianou Ma, Yiqing Xie, Jiarui Liu, Weihua Du, Sean Welleck, Yiming Yang, Graham Neubig, Tongshuang Wu, Maarten Sap (Carnegie Mellon University, Language Technologies Institute).  
   URL: [https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.11245](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.11245)

5. **ConvApparel: A Benchmark Dataset and Validation Framework for User Simulators in Conversational Recommenders** — Uses human–AI conversations, deliberately good and bad recommenders, and counterfactual validation to measure and reduce the simulator realism gap. **People:** Ofer Meshi, Krisztian Balog, Sally Goldman, Avi Caciularu, Guy Tennenholtz, Jihwan Jeong, Amir Globerson, Craig Boutilier (Google).  
   URL: [https://aclanthology.org/2026.eacl-long.244/](https://aclanthology.org/2026.eacl-long.244/)
